meta.title: TSV Phönix Steinsfurt – Join the Team!
meta.description: Football in Steinsfurt: we're looking for footballers aged 18+ for our first and second team. Training, team spirit, community – come to a trial session!

hero.title: We want you to be part of the Phönix community
hero.subtitle: Aged 18+ and keen to play football? Get in touch – we'd love to arrange a chat or a trial session.

about.title: More than just a club
about.text: For decades, TSV Phönix Steinsfurt has been home to everyone who loves football. Whether you're ambitious or just play for fun – you'll find your place here, on and off the pitch.

teams.title: Find your team
teams.groupAlt: Team photo of the first and second team of TSV Phönix Steinsfurt

items.name: First team
items.vibe: Ambitious, well-drilled – and always hungry for the next win.

items.name: Second team
items.vibe: Perfect for starting out, coming back and getting match time.

items.title: Structured training
items.text: Varied sessions with a plan – technique, tactics, fitness.

items.title: Great pitch & facilities
items.text: Well-kept grass, artificial turf for winter, floodlights and modern changing rooms.

items.title: Athletic training
items.text: Strength, speed and stamina – trained specifically so you stay fit all season.

items.title: Kit
items.text: Training and match kit in club colours – provided by the club.

items.title: Team events
items.text: Footgolf, training camp, summer fest – we do a lot together.

items.title: Community
items.text: A club where people know each other – and look out for each other.

items.title: Season finale
items.text: At the end of the season we celebrate together – with all teams, coaches and supporters.

items.title: Locker-room party
items.text: After a win the music gets loud – the locker room is where we celebrate.

items.title: Team nights
items.text: LAN parties, barbecues, bowling – regular get-togethers, off the pitch too.

gallery.title: This is what TSV feels like

items.quote:
For young players who want to develop and take the next step, we're exactly the right club. Our coach backs young players, gives them the trust they need and lets them make mistakes so they can learn from them.

Our team is very well-drilled and the team spirit is truly special. We're like a small family where everyone looks out for each other. That creates a great environment where you feel at home as a player and can grow both on and off the pitch.
items.name: Jan Schumacher

items.quote: I've played for the club since the under-9s. I'd never want to go anywhere else.
items.name: Dale Werner

items.quote: Here you're not just a player – you're part of a team where togetherness, fun and supporting each other really matter. We want to achieve something together on the pitch, but we also have a really great community off it – and that's exactly what makes our team.
items.name: Dominik Streib

items.quote:
Reason 1: The bond between all of us is simply awesome – everyone supports everyone, in everything.

Reason 2: Everything the club does for the team around the games is just brilliant, and something we as players are really proud of.
items.name: Jonas Richter

training.title: Your way into the team
training.text: Want to join a session or come for a trial? Please get in touch with one of our contacts first (see Contact below) – then we know you're coming and can welcome you properly. Just bring your boots and some enthusiasm, we'll take care of the rest.
training.address: TSV Phönix Steinsfurt sports ground, 74889 Sinsheim-Steinsfurt, Germany

contact.title: Fancy it? Get in touch!
contact.text: Just message us on WhatsApp or give us a call – we'll get back to you quickly.
